description: This file is a shell script for performing remote feature control (RFC) in a set-top box environment. It manages RFC location transitions, logs activities, and updates configuration files based on timestamps and device type.

methods.name: rfcLogging
methods.description: Logs messages with a timestamp to the RFC log file.

methods.name: rfcMoveToNewLoc
methods.description: Handles transition of RFC files from old to new secure location, including copying files and updating lock files.
